item.minecraft.trident.lore: A reward for conquering the ocean monument, this item is both a weapon and a mobility tool while underwater.
item.minecraft.trident.usage: Hold use while in water, then release to launch yourself forward in your crosshair direction. If you hit an enemy while dashing, you stop dashing and deal damage.
item.beryllium.burst_crossbow.usage: Fires three projectiles rather than one, though with less velocity. Can shoot wind charges.
